description: Review the prose you added in recent work — code comments, docstrings, and Markdown — against four equal defects: **existence** (it should not have been written at all), **durability** / **narration** (it narrates the change instead of the code's lasting contract), **tightness** / **bloat** (it spends more words than it informs), and **negation** / **polar bear** (it denies a thing the change removed, so the mention survives as its own denial). Rewrites, moves and cuts in place. Invoke as: /tend-prose [lens] [optional focus guidance] — naming one of the four, by either of its names, runs only that lens.
